revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the operations desk framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The risk review no longer accepts a plan that is only good in the central case. The same front-office choices have to make sense across the cases in the data pack, while the case-specific consequences settle afterward. Headquarters now wants the two-year aircraft plan to read like an actual readiness program. Each jet-year must be committed to training, combat duty, or a mixed posture. Mixed-use aircraft still support combat availability, but their pilot-training yield is discounted by `dual_use_training_efficiency`. The year-2 combat line must reach `combat_jet_min_year2`, and the training pipeline cannot lean on more than `training_intensity_cap` of the fleet in either year. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
